note: A warm-up (DayShape2): part 3 of the guitar warm-up run, picked by its kind and never for a path step. A slow trill for finger strength, closing the run; it is pitched at beginner, so a brand new player's run ends with the spider.

exercise.title: A slow trill with two fingers
exercise.why: A hammer-on and a pull-off sound a note with the fretting hand alone, so a slow trill wakes each finger's own strength before fast playing needs it.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome at {{=bpm}}. The tab under it shows the trill: frets 5 and 7 on the G string, with fingers 1 and 3. Pick the first note once. Then, without picking again, hammer finger 3 onto its fret and pull it off again, one note per beat.
Rest when your hand gets tired, then go again.
_Stop when your hand starts to hurt: the trill should feel light, never forced._
